# G.Creators

> The AI Operating System for creators, experts, and educators — build, scale, and monetize your creator business on one AI-powered platform.

G.Creators replaces a fragmented stack of tools with a unified OS for creators. Train an AI twin of yourself, run a storefront, sell digital products and sessions, and grow your audience across formats and languages.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the G.Creators platform and how it works.
- [Find Creators](/creators): Browse vetted creators, coaches, and industry experts.
- [Sign In / Sign Up](/auth): Create an account or sign in.

## Optional

- [Example Creator Profile](/creators): Public creator profiles live at /creators/:id.
- [Example Storefront](/creators): Public storefronts live at /:username.
